_note: Copy to keys.json (gitignored). Or use env: DV_ETHERSCAN_KEY / DV_BLOCKSCOUT_KEY / DV_SOLANA_KEY / DV_SCANNER_KEY_<chainId>. Browser: stored in localStorage via the ApiKeyManager UI. A key is OPTIONAL — every call works on the public endpoint without one; the key only lifts the rate limit + unlocks endpoints.
